skill_name: Write a story starting with "He had always wanted to visit the moon".
workflow: He had always wanted to visit the moon ever since he was a kid, but it seemed like a farfetched dream. He was in college now, and he was still dreaming of this incredible achievement. He read books, researched topics, and kept up to date with the latest news and trends in space exploration. Finally, after years of hard work, he had accumulated enough money to make his dream come true. He bought a ticket to a space shuttle, and on the night of the launch, his entire family was there to see him of
